PET SITTING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into on April 10, 2026, by and between Rose City Pet Care LLC ("Sitter") and Jane Doe ("Owner").

1. SERVICES AND CARE
Sitter agrees to provide pet-sitting and dog walking services for Owner's dog at Owner's residence in Portland, Oregon. Sitter shall follow all reasonable care instructions provided in writing by Owner.

2. FEES AND CANCELLATION
Owner shall pay $50 per visit, invoiced weekly in advance. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours written notice are strictly non-refundable and forfeited in full.

3. LIABILITY AND INDEMNIFICATION
Owner agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold Sitter harmless from any and all claims, damages, liabilities, or injuries caused by the pet during the provision of services. Sitter's aggregate liability under this agreement for any incident, negligence, or breach shall be strictly limited to the total fees paid under this agreement in the thirty (30) days preceding the claim.

4. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Oregon, without regard to its conflict of law principles. Any dispute or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Multnomah County, Oregon, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of such courts.
